items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a: is the external_task cap recalibration a shippable RULE or seed-idiosyncratic? (margin-normalised cap vs best absolute cap)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-934 (PASS, GOV-FANOUT-1 leg H1). 934 showed a mixed external_task occupancy regime is REACHABLE and reported a winning cap band [0.75, 1.75] -- but that band is the min/max of each seed's OWN best cap, not a common operating point: re-reading 934's banked ARM_SYMMETRIC cells, NO single absolute cap grades on more than 1 of 3 seeds (0.75 -> 1/3, 1.0/1.25/1.5 -> 0/3, 1.75 -> 1/3). This run asks the shippability question that leaves open: is the recalibration a RULE or per-seed hand-tuning? Normalising each seed's cap by its own baseline external_task margin collapses every graded cell in 934 into r = cap/m_seed = 2.22/2.28/2.23, so cap = R_STAR * m_seed with a single pre-registered R_STAR = 2.25 (the MEAN of those three, computed before this run) is tested head-to-head against the best absolute cap (1.75). RE-DERIVE BRAKE CLEARED on two independent routes: (a) the governing autopsy failure_autopsy_mech266-464e-467e-cluster_2026-08-13 refuses only 'a naked 464f/467f re-queue at the same AFFINITY_INPUT_CAP behind the same min()-based gate' and explicitly licenses new questions/DVs -- this is a new EXQ number, a new manipulation (per-seed normalised cap, never a fixed one), a new control arm, and uses regime_occupancy_gate, never min-across-the-sweep; (b) the brake's named upstream substrate 'mode-governance-engagement' has LANDED (salience_affinity_input_cap, ree-v3 9bcde4cb63; substrate_queue implemented_pending_validation) and this run is part of its validation. Prior braking autopsies counted: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-460b-461b-464b-466b_2026-06-04, failure_autopsy_SD-034-closure-cluster-ext_2026-06-12, failure_autopsy_backlog_2026-07-24, failure_autopsy_grandfathered-r5-batch23-mixed-findings_2026-08-08. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = occupancy at a per-seed cap derived from that seed's own baseline margin. Checked against the only compatible banked source, V3-EXQ-934 (substrate_hash f53db12dd0a7...8ddeb). PARTIALLY recoverable -- 934's grid happens to place exactly ONE cell per seed near r~2.2 (which is what made the hypothesis visible) but that is n=1 per seed on an undesigned r grid with the third seed 0.0002 outside the band, and contains NO out-of-sample seed. So this is the documented 'downgrade to a minimal targeted run' route: it adds only the designed r axis, the matched absolute control, and seeds 45/46, and re-derives nothing 934 already banked. CIRCULARITY: R_STAR was fitted on seeds 42/43/44, so C2 is scored on the new seeds 45/46 ALONE and is load-bearing; C2 is scoped out (never scored as a falsification) if neither is testable, and the manifest then records the circularity caveat as UNDISCHARGED. Seed 44 is deliberately retained (the reef-config seed-44 caution does not apply: 934 ran it here with guard_pass=True, contact_rate=0.3064) because it is the only seed that graded at NO absolute cap, so dropping it would bias the comparison toward the rule. DV-SYMMETRY (mandatory per-arm declaration): DV = fraction_in_external_task, a function of argmax(operating_mode); its symmetry group is (i) a constant added to ALL mode logits and (ii) a monotone transform applied identically to all. ARM_NORM is NOT invariant -- the cap clamps each affinity input BEFORE per-mode weighting while external_task_bias is added afterwards and is never clamped, so it moves logit DIFFERENCES, not a common offset, and a clamp is not a monotone map; empirically non-invariant (934 seed 42: 0.5606 -> 0.0317 -> 0.0). ARM_ABS is NOT invariant by the same argument (934 seed 43: 1.0 -> 0.4447). SUBSTRATE-PATH GATE (2.5c): the only open substrate_queue entry with a code footprint is mech203-valence-pool-admissibility, severity UNSET -> no action. The corrupting 'mode-governance-engagement' entry is closed under the gate predicate (implemented_pending_validation) and is the very entry this run validates. SMOKE: PASS (--dry-run, rc=0). The smoke CAUGHT AND FIXED a real defect before queuing: the dry-run r subset excluded R_STAR, so the load-bearing C1 was evaluated on an absent cell yet the run still routed the cap_recalibration_is_seed_idiosyncratic VERDICT label. Fixed by _r_values() (dry-run subset now always contains R_STAR) plus a new r_star_cell_measured readiness gate (threshold 1.0) that self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than letting an unmeasured C1 read as a falsification. Re-smoked: all four gates True, n_testable=1, C1/C2/C3 all evaluated, verdict path reached, no manifest written. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings.

items.title: MECH-467 three-leg distractor battery redesign -- guaranteed leg-(c) event denominator, selection-path rule read, encoding-side registration index
items.note: REDESIGN superseding V3-EXQ-874, routed by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-874_2026-08-03 (confirmed; governance 2026-08-03) after leg (c) returned a 0/0 event denominator in all 6 cells. Three changes, each with its own reason. (1) LEG (c) EVENT FLOOR. The autopsy routed 'denser targets and/or a longer horizon'. A pre-authoring probe (2026-08-16, P0-trained agent, this substrate) found the binding constraint is narrower: at 10x10/5-resources the agent moved on 14 of 300 ticks and visited ~10 cells, 0 events in both arms -- a longer horizon alone multiplies a ~0 rate by a constant. Shrinking to 6x6 at ~3x density produced 3 events per arm per 300 ticks AND brought z_goal live, so the event floor and the leg-(b) instrument below are the same precondition. Rejected: toroidal wrap (restores 100% movement but agent_health hits 0 by tick ~25 even at num_hazards=0) and an external_task arm (that IS the during-commitment arm the claim's SEQUENCING CAUTION excludes). A pre-registered pooled event floor now gates leg (c) -- the gap the claim's leg-(a)-only guard left open, named by the autopsy. (2) LEG (b) READ AT THE SELECTION PATH, from 2026-08-16_mech_467_goal_neglect_rule_reportable_duncan2008 (corroborated by ..._oculomotor_capture_awareness_adams2021): Duncan's mechanism is that task-model components are lost from the OPERATIVE model, so a storage-site drift read lets plain leg-2 rule corruption produce leg 3's exact signature. Added: Spearman fidelity of the per-candidate goal-score ranking under the current vs the warmup-established z_goal, sampled only on genuine E3 selections (n_latched_ticks recorded). PASS now needs BOTH reads intact. NOT the SD-033a bias head: its last Linear is zeroed by default and V3-EXQ-822/822a measured rule_state->action-bias propagation at exactly 0.0, so a counterfactual on it is structurally vacuous. (3) LEG (a) BECOMES AN ENCODING-SIDE INDEX, from 2026-08-16_mech_467_salient_distractor_suppression_gaspelin2017: registered-then-suppressed and never-encoded give the same proximity reading, so the claim's guard could self-route substrate_not_ready on a substrate that handled the distractor CORRECTLY. Replaced with z_world displacement under distractor-field ablation (probe-measured 0.000-0.706, live), reported as a trial-level distribution not a block mean (suppression fluctuates within a session). ARMS: the claim's timing axis (internal_planning / internal_replay; during-commitment EXCLUDED) crossed with a Duncan rule-set-complexity axis (2 vs 4 SD-049 resource types), because Duncan's load result is that neglect is driven by task-model complexity, not moment-to-moment demand -- a battery that cranks distraction at a 2-category rule set may return a floor that reflects the design. No detect-and-correct arm: Adams & Gaspelin 2021 predicts monitoring is insufficient (humans have the signal; it does not fix the behaviour). BOTH EVIDENCE DIRECTIONS. supports = >=1 GREEN arm with storage drift < 0.05 AND selection-path fidelity >= 0.90 AND wrong-target rate minus the MEASURED chance baseline >= 0.10 (behavioural capture with the operative rule intact -- MECH-467's leg-3 prediction). does_not_support = green arms exist and show no wrong-target elevation above chance while the operative rule is intact, i.e. behavioural capture does not dissociate from rule corruption on this substrate. non_contributory = all arms red on the preconditions (event floor / encoding floor / instrument-sensitivity control), which self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than a verdict. DV-SYMMETRY, per arm. The leg-(c) DV is a rate over consumption events; its symmetry group is permutation of events and relabelling of non-selected candidates. TIMING arms: the operating-mode pin changes the SD-033a write gate, hence rule_state's trajectory, hence the goal-score ranking, hence which cell is entered -- not invariant, and V3-EXQ-874 already measured the pin moving drift 0.22 vs 0.015 (reproduced in smoke: 0.098 vs 0.005). COMPLEXITY arms: distractor CELL DENSITY is not the manipulation -- what changes is how many distinct rule categories those cells carry -- and the DV is an EXCESS over the chance baseline measured at each event from the env's own live composition, so it cannot be an arithmetic identity of the spawn (the SD-049 allocator is stochastic, so the baseline is measured, never assumed from nominal weights). ENCODING index: the manipulation zeroes the encoder's own input block, so it is not invariant under any transform leaving z_world fixed; probe-measured non-zero. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readouts are (i) conditioned wrong-target EXCESS over a measured chance baseline, (ii) selection-path operative-rule fidelity, (iii) encoding-side distractor registration. Checked v3_exq_874_mech467_distractor_resistance_20260802T222132Z_v3 (the only MECH-467 manifest in the corpus) and the V3-EXQ-484 distractor family: NONE of the three is recorded or derivable -- 874 recorded a proximity proxy, a storage-site drift and a 0/0 rate, with no chance baseline, no selection-path read and no encoding-side read. Not recoverable -> run. KNOWN OPEN DEFECT overlapping this driver's code footprint: substrate_queue MECH091-SALIENT-EVENT-TRIGGER-WIRING, severity degrading, ree_core/agent.py. Not blocking (no corrupting overlap); recorded so a later autopsy can see the run happened under it. Arm cells are reuse-INELIGIBLE by design: the P0 warmup is shared across the two timing arms of each (seed, ruleset), the sanctioned shared-mutable-state reason. Smoke PASS (--dry-run): all three legs non-trivially engaged (consumption_events 5, encoding_samples 32, fidelity_samples 18), gate green on 2 arms, and the fidelity positive control read -0.41 to 0.45 against a 0.70 ceiling. That control is load-bearing and it earned its place: the FIRST smoke read real fidelity at 0.9994-1.0000 with the control ALSO at 0.65-0.93, i.e. a randomised z_goal reproduced the ranking, so 'operative rule intact' would have carried no information. The statistic was corrected to the rule-attributable component sum_t <z_world_t, z_goal> (the full-proximity ranking is dominated by a candidate-magnitude term present for ANY goal); the full-proximity fidelity is still recorded alongside. Diagnostic over existing substrate -- no new attention module, per the standing containment rule. MECH-262 continues to own leg 2.
